svg.title: Spead AI stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18, TipTap, Konva, TanStack Query, Radix UI, i18next. Backend: Node 22, Fastify 5, Prisma 6, Socket.IO, Model Context Protocol SDK. Data: PostgreSQL 16, pgvector, Redis. AI: Gemini, Gemini embeddings, Contextual RAG, Reranking. Ops: Playwright, pdf-lib, pptxgenjs, docx, Jest, nginx, systemd
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
